title: Dragging windows etc. via MobaXterm RDP Connection doesn't work when using "always on top"

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: A pinned Chrome window is reported to interfere with mouse actions in MobaXterm RDP sessions; the reporter provided a recording and confirmed persistence in 2024.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent Always on Top from interfering with remote session input
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the topmost window or its border interferes with MobaXterm input handling; this needs isolation before changing input or z-order behavior.
plan: Reproduce with and without the border and with Always on Top disabled.
Inspect input hit-testing and focus at the failing remote interaction.
Correct the demonstrated interaction and add a focused regression scenario without changing normal pinned-window behavior.
